inspection_scope: Complete supplied script, five rhetorical chapters, eight setups, twelve beat contracts, asset descriptions and continuity lifecycles. Data-only assessment of planned structure and hierarchy.

checks.evidence: Separate computers, app connections, ordered processing, pitch classification, permission, commercial access and working participation occupy distinct worlds. Within s04, proposed work examples remain inside sequentially revealed folio layers; the folio is not retained as permission or access machinery.

s03 compresses processed folds, s04 folds present-use leaves away, and s07 transforms the answer panel into part of the work surface. Networks, processing machinery and access ledges do not travel into subsequent setups. The stopped slips in s05 communicate pending work.

App sockets form one connection group; accordion stops form one ordered job; paired entrances form one access comparison. s04 sequences present uses, specialist review and planned team sockets rather than assigning them simultaneous dominance.

Shot contracts move through offset computers, a diagonal socket network, an accordion depth corridor, facing folio leaves, shutter contact, paired entrances and a vertical-to-horizontal work surface. The final shutter callback changes the primary region from slip contact to the human-held key.

The notched Dot changes location and role across worlds while leaving previous sets behind. The human-key appears at the permission caveat and returns in the retained grip at the ending; it never transfers or implies approval.

Declared geometry supplies computing separation, connection endpoints, process stages, status boundaries, access conditions or human control. Foreground sheets establish concurrent user activity; asymmetrical folds, sockets and ledges distinguish meaningful states.

Connection resets to processing, processing to pitch classification, classification to permission, permission to commercial access, and access to participation. Naming and the coworker transformation continue their existing arguments without unnecessary resets.

Contracts sequence socket contacts, folio layers and access reveals. s03's foreground activity supports the background-work proposition; s05 makes the key subordinate to slip contact; s08 reverses that hierarchy. Multiple objects generally serve one causal action.

Independent stations, connected sockets, traversed steps, veiled and unopened layers, stopped slips, unequal entrances and withheld key transfer carry the central relationships visually. Local labels identify products and qualifications rather than replacing those actions.

setup_assessments.evidence: b01–b02 introduce separate computing, sustain work across a time change and uncover the same token's identity. Establishing and detail framings develop one newcomer rather than retaining unrelated mechanisms.
b03–b04 replace containment with seated app connections, then reveal the connected agent's separate computing shelf. The shelf becomes dominant while the related network remains contextual.
b05 orders processing before draft emergence and compresses completed folds. Concurrent foreground page turning gives the background process a meaningful relationship to user activity.

b06 assembles two proposed-use pockets. b07 folds those leaves away, shows specialist review behind a preview boundary, then shifts focus to unopened team sockets. Examples and restrictions develop a sequential pitch display.
b08 brings a proposed slip into visible shutter contact and leaves it pending. The queued slip reinforces the stop; the held key remains subordinate and outside the Dot's control.
b09 sequentially exposes a ticket requirement and an unobstructed alternative entrance. Separate subscription extras remain subordinate; neither side performs a capability contest.
b10 physically folds the answer panel into an expanded work surface. b11 fills its new coworker position and continues assigned work across a time change, completing the transformation's argument.
b12 returns to the permission world with the human-held key as the primary action. Its approach ends before contact or transfer, preserving the unresolved decision.

limits: Data-only review cannot establish rendered/mobile performance, actual visibility, contact execution, caption timing or listening quality. Narration spans cover words 0–125 in order, and b01–b12 are assigned once. The b03 instruction to remove the chat enclosure conflicts with b04's background open-chat silhouette; clarify that lifecycle before implementation. Either treatment can preserve the related connection context without introducing another mechanism.
